title: 10KSwap (Starknet) — Uniswap-V2 Cairo AMM, 15 live pairs; deployed code = audited source; no unprivileged extraction path
closed_reasons: pair.initialize re-init: caller-gated (assert caller == factory, error '10kSwap: FB'); proven by starknet_call (all 4 pairs revert) and simulateTransactions (revert at pc 0:2893 with factory != caller)
skim(): actual token balances == stored reserves exactly on all 15 pairs (excess = 0 wei); simulateTransactions skim transfers value 0
swap without paying: reverts '10kSwap: IIA' (amountIn == 0), k-check ('10kSwap: K') also enforced; 0.3% fee identical for attacker
stranded LP: LP balanceOf(pair) == 0 on all 15 pairs (nothing a third party can burn)
deployed pair/factory/router class hashes reproduced from the audited public source in CI (cairo-lang 0.9.1 + OZ 0.3.2); normalized program equality + entrypoints + ABI all match
no admin functions on pairs; factory admin (feeToSetter) can only redirect future protocol fees, cannot touch reserves/LP
leaked .env.example private keys (audit .EN-1) are devnet/testnet accounts not deployed on Starknet mainnet (getClassHashAt -> Contract not found)

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from 10KSwap: the 15 V2 pairs ($767.4K reserves) are a faithful Cairo port whose deployed class hashes reproduce the audited source, re-initialization is caller-gated, skim excess is zero, no LP is stranded, and the k-check/IIA gate block unpaid swaps; $760.4K belongs to LP holders (H-O), $7.0K accrued fees + $218.4K treasury to the feeTo/admin Argent account (P), $41 stuck dust (S).
